rom.name: Pebble Beach no Hatou New - Tournament Edition (Japan).sfc

note: Run with retro-run --pad2 (through .cache/build/make-save-pad2.py, otherwise tools/make-save.py): a joypad is plugged into port 2 as well, as RetroArch does. With port 2 never set, bsnes-jg dereferences a null controller in CPU::joypadEdge on the first frame.
